tb: TB is a metallic element of the rare earth group.
TB can also mean infection transmitted by inhalation or ingestion of tubercle bacilli and manifested in fever and small lesions.
TB can also mean a unit of information equal to 1000 gigabits or 10^12 bits.
TB means the same as terbium or atomic number 65 or tuberculosis.
tbilisi: Tbilisi is the capital and largest city of Georgia on the Kura river.
Tbilisi means the same as Tiflis or capital of Georgia.
tbit: Tbit is a unit of information equal to 1000 gigabits or 10^12 bits.
Tbit means the same as terabit or Tb.
